note_alts: semi-independent: contemporaneous, correlated assets; not a disjoint holdout universe
signal_definition: resample_to_interval(df, 180); atr_raw=ta.ATR(...,14); atr=atr_raw*2.0; close_change=close.diff(); signal |close_change| > atr.shift(1) on the 3h grid
F_k: direction * (close[t+k] - close[t]) / atr[t]; k in 3h bars; F_8 = 24h
MAE_8: max 24h adverse 1h excursion after 3h close / atr[t]

gate_B.need: BTC bucket9, BTC bucket21, ETH bucket9, ETH bucket21 each >=4/5 years below that year's eight-bucket median
